essence: Performing libation and purification yields mantra accomplishment.
Offering palāśa flowers in fire paralyzes enemy strength.
Offering with mālatī yields unequalled prosperity while other steps remain unchanged.
The mantra begins with oṃ, obeisance to the lord, and the three vyāhṛtis.
The sequence continues with 'vyāpakāya', a ṅe-ending form, and 'Trivikrama'.
